questions.q: How does the business urgency of a Receivables aging balance differ from a Payables aging balance?
options: They carry identical urgency in every respect
An aging Receivables balance represents incoming cash that hasn't arrived yet, directly affecting cash on hand; an aging Payables balance represents delayed outgoing cash
Receivables aging has no connection to cash flow at all
Payables aging only matters for tax purposes
questions.explain: Receivables aging reflects money owed to the company that hasn't been collected, which affects available cash more urgently than delayed outgoing payments.

questions.q: Why are customer statements typically generated through BI Publisher rather than OTBI?
options: OTBI cannot connect to Receivables data
Customer statements never contain any data at all
BI Publisher is only used for Payables, never Receivables
Customer statements need a consistent, professional, pixel-perfect layout every time, for potentially hundreds of customers — exactly BI Publisher's use case
questions.explain: The customer-facing, templated, repeatable nature of statements fits the pixel-perfect scheduled output BI Publisher is built for.

questions.q: What does an invoice register in Receivables list?
options: Depreciation schedules for fixed assets
A list of OTBI subject areas
Scheduled BI Publisher job definitions
Invoices issued during a period, useful for audit and reconciliation
questions.explain: An invoice register lists invoices issued during a period, serving an audit and reconciliation purpose similar to Payables' payment registers.

questions.q: What does a receipts register list?
options: Supplier invoices awaiting approval
GL journal entries only
Payments (receipts) received from customers during a period
Fixed asset additions
questions.explain: A receipts register lists customer payments received during a period, helping confirm recorded cash receipts match actual incoming payments.

questions.q: How does a collections team typically prioritize its daily work using the Receivables aging report?
options: Randomly, with no relationship to the aging data
By only contacting customers with zero balance
Collections teams do not use aging reports at all
By following up on the oldest and largest past-due balances first, escalating as accounts age further without payment
questions.explain: Aging data drives prioritization, with escalation increasing the longer a balance remains unpaid.
